capabilities.label: Process context
capabilities.description: Process identity, parent and lifetime when retained.

capabilities.label: Workload identity
capabilities.description: Boot-scoped workload lifetime and authenticated actor-to-job binding.

capabilities.label: Kernel operation
capabilities.description: Scoped operation result and resolved object identification.

capabilities.label: Bound delegation receipt
capabilities.description: Authenticated request and terminal-to-target binding from the tested helper.

capabilities.label: Authorization
capabilities.description: Applicable intended policy for the realized operation and exact target.

capabilities.label: Independent outcome witness
capabilities.description: Independently scoped readback or destination result.

capabilities.label: Process EDR
capabilities.description: Process start, parent and lifetime fields vary by agent.

capabilities.label: Endpoint file and integrity
capabilities.description: Check supported object identity, access mode, write completion and generation fields.

capabilities.label: Kernel and runtime
capabilities.description: Require the actual hook, result semantics and lifetime or incarnation fields.

capabilities.label: Management and orchestration audit
capabilities.description: Check the retained stage, authenticated principal and runtime mapping.

capabilities.label: Bound job receipts
capabilities.description: Exact authenticated request and terminal result for the named controller. Generic audit often lacks them.

capabilities.label: Authorization records
capabilities.description: Intended policy, effective interval and relevant exception or approval.

capabilities.label: Independent outcome witness
capabilities.description: Destination-side read, state, execution or trust evidence at the specified scope.

capabilities.label: containerd task-start topic
capabilities.description: Exact task-start topic from a containerd envelope. This is an activity lead outside the Gate C.2 lens totals.

variations.title: Privileged runtime delegation
variations.objective: Bind a host-enabled operation to its workload and result.

hunt.P: Look for an initiating process and its lifetime. It is context for the job.
hunt.W: Check that the workload lifetime and authenticated requester bind to the same job.
hunt.K: Inspect operation completion and the resolved object when the sensor retains both.
hunt.D: Look for a trusted job terminal bound to the target or result.
hunt.A: Compare the realized action and resource with the policy that applied at the time.
hunt.H: Inspect the designated readback or destination result independently of the job record.
hunt.containerd-topic: Use the matching task-start topic to orient the investigation by runtime namespace and task. Look for separate request, terminal and outcome records.

claims.label: Independently confirm the downstream effect
claims.qualification: Bind the terminal and witness to the same result. The fixture effect is neutral.

claims.label: Resolve authorization for the downstream action
claims.qualification: Compare requester, terminal, target and valid-time policy. This supports policy qualification; production detection fidelity is unmeasured.

claims.label: Investigate workload origin
claims.qualification: Verify ownership, overlapping lifetimes and the request-to-job binding. This projection carries no standalone attribution count.

claims.label: Reconstruct the workload-to-effect relationship
claims.qualification: Require the exact workload lifetime, job, policy, target and outcome; check competing operations.

variations.limitation: Only the measured Gate C.2 delegated workload cohort under augmented replay. Inert fixtures and a fixed helper; no production escape, SSH login or collector performance measured.
variations.legitimate: Approved runtime maintenance or software deployment can use the same authority.

variations.title: Granted host mapping
variations.objective: Hunt for high-risk host mappings, unusual resource access, or a workload near an independently observed host change.

hunt.kernel: Inspect process execution, host-resource access, file and integrity changes for the selected variation.
hunt.file: Inspect host-resource access, file and integrity changes for the selected variation.
hunt.proc: Inspect process execution for the selected variation.
hunt.dest: Inspect independent destination outcomes for the selected variation.
hunt.auth: Inspect authorization context for the selected variation.

claims.label: Occurred on a host-owned object
claims.qualification: The collector must retain a completed read or write and resolve the exact object, actor and version.

claims.label: Designated data reached this recipient
claims.qualification: Join the version-bound completed read to an independently scoped recipient.

claims.label: This use was outside intended policy
claims.qualification: Match identity, resource, action, and policy valid time.

variations.limitation: Scope the claim to this route and the available records.
variations.legitimate: Approved host backup or a node agent.

variations.title: Namespace-mediated access
variations.objective: Hunt for unusual namespace tools, target selectors, and container-to-host process context. Approved node debugging can look similar.

hunt.kernel: Inspect process execution, namespace transitions, host-resource access for the selected variation.
hunt.proc: Inspect process execution for the selected variation.
hunt.dest: Inspect independent destination outcomes for the selected variation.
hunt.auth: Inspect authorization context for the selected variation.

claims.label: Relevant namespace transition occurred
claims.qualification: Require namespace type, real target, result, and workload lifetime. Generic process-only records cannot substitute.

claims.label: Host action followed this transition
claims.qualification: Qualify actual resulting authority, resulting actor and exact action. Evaluate policy separately.

variations.limitation: Scope the claim to this route and the available records.
variations.legitimate: Approved node debugging or runtime housekeeping.

variations.title: Runtime-materialized copy
variations.objective: Hunt unusual workload creation and volume handling. Investigate local reads without assuming a new host-side read.

hunt.file: Inspect host-resource access, file and integrity changes for the selected variation.
hunt.dest: Inspect independent destination outcomes for the selected variation.
hunt.kernel: Inspect process execution, host-resource access, runtime management operations, file and integrity changes for the selected variation.

claims.label: Workload acquired a local copy
claims.qualification: Require version-scoped local read and named recipient. This does not prove host provenance.

claims.label: The copy came from the designated host version
claims.qualification: A trusted materialization record must link the specific source version to the copy and recipient. Verify actual fields.

variations.limitation: Scope the claim to this route and the available records.
variations.legitimate: Approved projection, backup or support collection.

variations.title: Runtime binary replacement
variations.objective: Hunt unexpected runtime binary changes and nearby launches. Correlate by file generation before asserting causation.

hunt.file: Inspect file and integrity changes for the selected variation.
hunt.dest: Inspect independent destination outcomes for the selected variation.
hunt.proc: Inspect process execution for the selected variation.
hunt.kernel: Inspect process execution, runtime management operations, file and integrity changes for the selected variation.

claims.label: A host runtime binary changed
claims.qualification: Before/after identity or trusted integrity witness must identify the same target and generation.

claims.label: The affected generation ran under host authority
claims.qualification: Prove actual consumption and qualified authority. Check the authorized upgrade twin.

variations.limitation: Scope the claim to this route and the available records.
variations.legitimate: Approved runtime package update or normal service restart.

variations.title: Device setup plus a daemon job
variations.objective: Hunt unusual setup changes and unexpected controller activity. Inspect separate enforcement at both boundaries.

hunt.kernel: Inspect namespace transitions, host-resource access, runtime management operations for the selected variation.
hunt.management: Inspect runtime management operations for the selected variation.
hunt.job: Inspect host-resource access, runtime management operations for the selected variation.
hunt.dest: Inspect independent destination outcomes for the selected variation.
hunt.auth: Inspect authorization context for the selected variation.

claims.label: Unintended mapping and daemon reach were present
claims.qualification: Resolve actual mount scope and controller access. Read-only does not establish absence of socket activity.

claims.label: A host-enabled job used this composed route
claims.qualification: Join the originating setup, the authenticated job terminal, and actual host outcome.

variations.limitation: Scope the claim to this route and the available records.
variations.legitimate: Approved accelerator setup or node maintenance.

variations.title: Effective local SSH trust
variations.objective: Hunt trust source changes and destination authentication while the change origin is unresolved.

hunt.dest: Inspect independent destination outcomes for the selected variation.
hunt.auth: Inspect authorization context for the selected variation.
hunt.proc: Inspect process execution for the selected variation.
hunt.file: Inspect file and integrity changes for the selected variation.
hunt.kernel: Inspect process execution, file and integrity changes for the selected variation.

claims.label: A named key became eligible for this account
claims.qualification: Use exact account, key and connection context. Evaluate effective resolver and intended change policy separately.

claims.label: The workload caused the trust change
claims.qualification: Bind the exact trust input change or job to effective resolution and distinguish host-native or central issuance.

variations.limitation: Scope the claim to this route and the available records.
variations.legitimate: Approved key rotation or a configured trust publisher.

variations.title: Direct write diagnostic
variations.objective: Investigate the verified effect and check hook coverage across the applicable operation classes.

hunt.dest: Inspect independent destination outcomes for the selected variation.

claims.label: A controlled downstream state change was observed
claims.qualification: An independent scoped witness can support the fixture change even with the tested hook gap.

claims.label: Exact vectored completion from the selected hook
claims.qualification: Unavailable in the measured vectored arm. Selecting a generic kernel source cannot recover the missed record.

variations.limitation: Scope the claim to this route and the available records.
variations.legitimate: An approved application that uses a different write implementation.

variations.title: Direct canary model • Gate B
variations.objective: Use the synthetic cases to test reasoning about missing evidence. Gate C found no qualifying direct measured combination.

hunt.kernel: Inspect process execution for the selected variation.
hunt.auth: Inspect authorization context for the selected variation.

claims.label: Direct canary effect can be confirmed in this model
claims.qualification: The Gate B modeled W/K/H set also requires exact workload incarnation. This profile choice only illustrates the evidence categories.

variations.limitation: Scope the claim to this route and the available records.
variations.legitimate: An authorized change can produce the same observed host state.

rows.label: Independent outcome
rows.definition: A distinct readback or destination witness for a scoped result.

rows.label: Bound runtime job
rows.definition: A management job with a qualified request or terminal binding.

rows.label: Kernel / runtime operation
rows.definition: Subject, object, operation and result, as captured by the named collector.

rows.label: File / integrity
rows.definition: Creation, write or state-change observations for a resolved object and generation.

rows.label: Process context
rows.definition: Process, image, interpreter, parent or lifetime observations scoped to a host.

rows.label: Workload identity
rows.definition: Runtime workload identity and authenticated workload lifetime binding.

rows.label: Authorization
rows.definition: Intended authorization or approved change evidence for the principal, action, resource and valid time.

rows.label: Management audit
rows.definition: Control-plane, runtime management or orchestration activity records.

cells.rationale: The independent witness is one part of the measured outcome minimum.
requiredFields: Target or result identity distinct from the runtime job record
cells.limitation: D/H confirms 9/9 neutral fixture effects and 0/7 causal relationships at final replay. An outcome alone does not establish a qualified job or cause.

cells.rationale: A matched helper terminal supplies the operation side of the delegated effect claim.
cells.limitation: D must join independently to H in this measured helper fixture. A request-only record is insufficient.

cells.rationale: The workload lifetime contributes to causal reconstruction when joined with authorization, the job and the effect.
cells.limitation: From D/H, W alone adds zero confirmed causal relationships. Adding W and A together adds seven of seven in this cohort.

cells.rationale: Applicable policy complements workload identity for the attributed job and effect.
requiredFields: Principal, realized action and exact target
cells.limitation: From D/H, A alone adds zero confirmed causal relationships. A policy record alone establishes no effect, and production fidelity remains unmeasured.

cells.rationale: The measured delegated final replay shows no additional effect or causal confirmations from K over the qualifying sets.
requiredFields: Exact operation, resolved object and result
cells.limitation: This result applies to the instrumented helper and the selected claims. Kernel telemetry can be central on other routes.

cells.rationale: The initiating process can orient an investigation around the workload lifetime.
requiredFields: Parent or process identity and workload lifetime
cells.limitation: Process context does not establish that a controller completed a job. No production coverage estimate follows.

cells.rationale: Daemon or orchestration activity can identify a request or an actor to pivot on.
requiredFields: Operation, subject, control-plane object and time
cells.limitation: A generic audit entry is not the bound terminal used in the measured replay.

cells.rationale: A scoped access operation can establish activity against a mapped object when its identity and scope are retained.
cells.limitation: Exposure and access are different. Outcome delivery and intended policy require additional evidence.

cells.rationale: File telemetry can corroborate a host mapping when joined to an initiating process.
requiredFields: Writer or accessing actor if retained
cells.limitation: A file path or state change alone does not bind an operation to a workload.

cells.rationale: An exact process binding complements the file observation when a kernel operation record is unavailable.
requiredFields: Process or parent identity linked to the object evidence
cells.limitation: An image name or path argument is a lead and can be reused or stale.

cells.rationale: Authorization identifies whether the observed object access was permitted.
requiredFields: Applicable workload policy, principal and object
cells.limitation: Policy grants and operation completion are separate.

cells.rationale: A scoped witness could establish delivery to the designated recipient.
requiredFields: Same object version or readback tied to observed access
cells.limitation: The prior assessment treats this witness as an opportunity. There is no measured general detection coverage.

cells.rationale: A matching kernel record can show a namespace transition with its subject and result.
cells.limitation: A successful transition does not establish a later host action.

cells.rationale: Process lineage can help bind the actor that performed a later action to the namespace transition.
cells.limitation: Scope lineage to the namespace type and actual process. A process event alone adds no namespace proof.

cells.rationale: Policy helps distinguish approved transitions from the modeled route once actor and result are established.
requiredFields: Intended caller permission and applicable namespace or host policy
cells.limitation: Permission alone does not establish activity.

cells.rationale: A separate destination or host witness could support the modeled later host action.
requiredFields: Independent result, resolved host target and qualifying actor/time link
cells.limitation: The proposed join is distinct from source documentation of the namespace transition.

cells.rationale: Scope the observed preparation or copy operation and link the source version to the created copy.
requiredFields: Operation result and destination copy identity
cells.limitation: A control request alone cannot establish file materialization or workload acquisition.

cells.rationale: A file observation can establish the identity of a runtime-created copy and help bind it to a recipient view.
cells.limitation: A local copy lacking provenance could be unrelated to the designated host version.

cells.rationale: Recipient visibility could corroborate acquisition of a specific materialized copy.
requiredFields: Independent observation of that copy or version
cells.limitation: The proposed receiver-side test has no production measurement.

cells.rationale: A resolved binary change is the evidence anchor for this variation.
requiredFields: Version, hash or generation and time
cells.limitation: Retain the affected generation and separate a change from later execution.

cells.rationale: An execution record can join the runtime invocation to the affected generation.
requiredFields: Executable generation or bound image identity
cells.limitation: A reused pathname is insufficient to establish consumption of the changed image.

cells.rationale: A scoped exec observation can help corroborate which generation actually ran.
cells.limitation: The site should qualify sensor coverage and bind the operation to the file evidence.

cells.rationale: Independent readback or a host execution witness could confirm the proposed outcome.
cells.limitation: A changed file alone is evidence of state change. It does not establish execution.

cells.rationale: Resolved host mapping and daemon reach are central to detecting the combined exposure.
requiredFields: Observed host scope or operation result
cells.limitation: The two steps need related identity and time. Reach alone does not prove that a job ran.

cells.rationale: Control-plane context links device setup or management access to the same workload.
cells.limitation: Setup and task completion need different records.

cells.rationale: A matched terminal corroborates completion of a host-enabled job after the exposure.
cells.limitation: Another authorized job may produce related records. Bind outcome and policy explicitly.

cells.rationale: Valid-time policy qualifies the observed use of both capabilities.
cells.limitation: Accepted setup permission is different from job permission.

cells.rationale: A separate witness could qualify the effect of the matched job.
requiredFields: Destination result and exact object-to-job binding
cells.limitation: The proposed witness is a dependency. No empirical coverage claim follows.

cells.rationale: A controlled effective-trust witness is the proposed evidence anchor for this route.
requiredFields: Applicable host trust resolution and resulting state
cells.limitation: The OpenSSH source documents resolution. This assessment proposes a witness and does not measure its reliability or equate eligibility with login.

cells.rationale: Applicable account and trust configuration qualify whether the named key became eligible.
requiredFields: Winning trust rule or principal binding
cells.limitation: Configuration or authorized key file evidence alone may miss effective resolution.

cells.rationale: A scoped local integrity observation could help link the workload to changed trust material.
requiredFields: Actor-to-write binding and matching effective trust outcome
cells.limitation: A file observation alone does not establish that SSH accepts the key.

cells.rationale: Actor and process lifetime could complement a file change for the local write path.
requiredFields: Actor link to the exact trust change
cells.limitation: A process event alone cannot establish independent effective trust.

cells.rationale: A resolved operation could link a qualified actor to an affected trust object.
requiredFields: Caller lifetime link to host action
cells.limitation: The path needs both authorization and independent effective trust evidence.

cells.rationale: A bound job could supply the operation actor and target in the delegated version of the trust check.
requiredFields: Exact key-account target and workload identity
cells.limitation: The delegated evidence chain for this objective is a hypothesis.

cells.rationale: The selected Tetragon hook retained no return for either of the separate vectored-write cases. Reference tracing saw both complete.
requiredFields: A retained return and resolved object binding where available
cells.limitation: This is a named capture gap. The outcome witness cannot substitute for the missed return, and the result does not generalize to all sensors.

cells.rationale: The independent witness observed the designated canary change.
requiredFields: Designated canary identity and matching independent readback
cells.limitation: A downstream state change does not supply the missed writer or exact actor/object link.

cells.rationale: A change record can help describe state, while the named return projection lacked a native durable object join.
requiredFields: Actor or stable file descriptor binding where available
cells.limitation: The approved result is a limitation of the tested capture. It does not validate generic file integrity telemetry.

cells.rationale: The measured fixture enrolled the actors for the invocations.
requiredFields: Enrolled process lifetime and fixture matching information
cells.limitation: Enrollment supplies context and cannot repair an absent completion record.

cells.rationale: The synthetic model supplies a targeted kernel operation for the direct write.
cells.limitation: The controlled replay says nothing about a deployed collector or an actual escape.

cells.rationale: Modeled intended-policy context helps qualify the direct action.
requiredFields: Modeled identity and expected grant for the target resource
cells.limitation: Modeled policy does not establish completion.

cells.rationale: The modeled witness supplies the independent canary result needed by this synthetic claim.
requiredFields: Separate canary observation and target binding
cells.limitation: No measured production detection result follows from this synthetic combination.
